description: This Java source file defines the DoubleEvaluator class, an arithmetic expression evaluator capable of parsing and computing expressions involving real numbers. It includes predefined operators, functions, constants, and supports configuration of evaluation parameters. The class extends an abstract evaluator and provides concrete implementations for evaluation of constants, operators, and functions, handling numeric parsing and operation execution.

classes.name: DoubleEvaluator
classes.description: A concrete evaluator class for performing arithmetic computations on real numbers with a rich set of operators, functions, and constants.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Represents a constant value in the evaluator (e.g., true, false).

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a function that can be invoked within expressions (e.g., sin, log, max).

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents an operator with precedence, associativity, and other properties.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Holds configuration including supported operators, functions, constants, and brackets.

methods.description: Evaluates constants, operators, or functions based on the symbol and operands provided.

methods.description: Retrieves a Function object by name from predefined functions.
